_comment: Fabricated data for the tracker's demo account. Every company, posting,
URL, salary and interview date below is invented. The companies are not
real companies, and every URL sits under example.com, which IANA reserves
for documentation and which can never resolve to a real job posting - so
nothing here can be mistaken for a record of a real hiring process.
Dates are day offsets, not calendar dates, so the demo reads as a search
that ran this week no matter when the seed is run. seed-demo-user.ps1
turns each *DaysAgo into a YYYY-MM-DD before posting it.

user.name: Demo
user.note: The login name, shown on the page and at sign-in. Deliberately not a person's name.

settings.footer_note: This is the tracker's demonstration account. Every posting in it is invented.

tracks.label: Engineering
tracks.full_description: Individual-contributor software engineering roles at the senior and staff level - backend, platform, infrastructure and full-stack.
tracks.role_search_line: Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer roles
tracks.search_note: None of these are industry-only searches - surface any matching engineering role at these companies, whatever the product area.
tracks.resume_line: Read docs/demo-profile.md for the candidate profile. This track frames that background as a hands-on backend and platform engineer who has shipped and operated production services.
tracks.fit_disqualifier: a fixed-term contract rather than a permanent role, a job whose stated core is an on-call rotation, or a role requiring relocation or five days a week on site
tracks.doc_summary: the running notes for this track - fetch reliability per board, and the expanded company net
tracks.intro_note: This account also tracks Eng Leadership (filled by this same search) and Data Science. Do not merge their docs with this one.

tracks.label: Eng Leadership
tracks.full_description: Engineering management roles - Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering. Same companies and same search as the Engineering tab; the only difference is that these manage engineers rather than write the code.

tracks.label: Data Science
tracks.full_description: Data science, machine learning and analytics engineering roles at the senior individual-contributor level.
tracks.role_search_line: Senior Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or ML Platform Engineer roles
tracks.resume_line: Read docs/demo-profile.md for the candidate profile. This track frames the same background around the analytics and modelling work rather than the service engineering.
tracks.fit_clause: a real fit (the posting's modelling or analytics work is the core of the role, not an occasional side duty)
tracks.fit_disqualifier: poor fit (a data title over what is really a reporting or dashboard-maintenance job)
tracks.doc_summary: the running notes for this track - fetch reliability per board, and the expanded company net
tracks.intro_note: This account also tracks Engineering and Eng Leadership. Do not merge their docs with this one.

leads.title: Senior Backend Engineer
leads.fit: Payments services in Go, on-call ownership, and a team that runs what it builds - close to the last four years of the profile.
leads.notes: Recruiter replied to the application; waiting on a screen time.

leads.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
leads.fit: Staff-level scope on internal platform tooling. The posting asks for multi-team technical leadership, which is a stretch but a stated one.

leads.title: Senior Gameplay Engineer
leads.fit: C++ gameplay systems on a shipped title - the closest thing on this board to the engine work in the profile.

leads.title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Systems
leads.fit: Consensus and replication work on a storage layer. Deep on the systems side, light on the product side, which suits.

leads.title: Backend Engineer, Data Platform
leads.fit: Pipeline and ingestion services rather than modelling - sits between this track and the Data Science one.

leads.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
leads.fit: TypeScript front to back with real backend ownership, not a UI-only role dressed up as full stack.

leads.title: Engine Programmer
leads.fit: Rendering and tooling on a proprietary engine. Strong overlap with the C++ half of the profile.

leads.title: Senior Software Engineer, Controls
leads.fit: Real-time controls with a hard requirement for embedded and ROS experience, neither of which is in this background.
leads.notes: Onsite in Austin with no relocation support, and the controls requirement reads as genuine rather than a wish list.

leads.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Streaming
leads.fit: Video delivery at scale - latency and cost work, which is the part of the last role that went best.

leads.title: Software Engineer III, Infrastructure
leads.fit: Kubernetes and internal deploy tooling. The level reads a notch below the rest of this list, so worth weighing against the band.

leads.title: Senior Engineer, Integrations
leads.fit: Health data integrations. HL7 and FHIR are learnable, and the posting says so rather than requiring them up front.

leads.title: Senior Tools Engineer
leads.fit: Right level and right city, but the work is internal tooling for artists rather than the services and platform work in the profile.
leads.notes: Marked not a fit by hand rather than screened by the run: it passed every stated rule, and the mismatch is a judgement about the work itself.

leads.title: Staff Engineer, Logistics Platform
leads.fit: Staff scope on a routing and scheduling platform. The domain is new, the systems problems are not.

leads.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
leads.fit: Design-systems work with real accessibility ownership. Frontend-heavy compared with the rest of this tab.

leads.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
leads.fit: SRE with a genuine reliability charter rather than a rebadged ops queue - the posting names error budgets and owns them.

leads.title: Software Engineer II, Payments
leads.fit: Same team as the senior posting above, one level down. Worth keeping visible in case the senior req closes.

leads.title: Senior Backend Engineer, API
leads.fit: Public API design and versioning, which is exactly the work described in the last two roles of the profile.

leads.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
leads.fit: Managing a platform team of six or seven. First-time-manager friendly, which the posting states outright.

leads.title: Engineering Manager, Core Services
leads.fit: A working-manager role - the posting expects code review and design ownership alongside the people work.

leads.title: Senior Engineering Manager
leads.fit: Two teams reporting in, with one tech lead between. A level up from the other management postings on this tab.

leads.title: Director of Engineering
leads.fit: Managing managers, with eight-plus years of leadership asked for as a hard line rather than a preference.
leads.notes: Two levels up rather than one. Left visible as a marker of where this tab's ceiling currently sits.

leads.title: Engineering Manager, Data
leads.fit: Manages the data engineering team - the one management posting here that also uses the Data Science background.

leads.title: Engineering Manager, Reliability
leads.fit: Same org as the SRE posting on the Engineering tab, found in the same sweep and filed here instead.

leads.title: Senior Data Scientist
leads.fit: Forecasting and experiment design, owned end to end. The modelling is the role rather than a side duty.

leads.title: Machine Learning Engineer
leads.fit: Training and serving infrastructure rather than research. Leans on the engineering half of the background.

leads.title: Data Scientist, Product Analytics
leads.fit: Product experimentation with a stated say in what gets shipped, not a request queue.

leads.title: Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting
leads.fit: Load forecasting for a utility, with a doctorate and a publication record required as a hard line.
leads.notes: The doctorate requirement is stated as non-negotiable in the posting itself.

leads.title: Analytics Engineer
leads.fit: Warehouse modelling and transformation work. Less statistics than the rest of this tab, more engineering, and the posting is honest about that.

leads.title: Computational Biologist
leads.fit: Genomics pipelines. The domain would be new, but the posting weighs pipeline engineering as heavily as the biology.

leads.title: Data Scientist, Infrastructure Insights
leads.fit: Capacity and cost modelling for the same infrastructure org as the Engineering tab's posting. Unusually good overlap of both tracks.

leads.title: ML Platform Engineer
leads.fit: Feature store and training pipeline ownership - the platform side of ML rather than the modelling side.
